I report completi con per_recording restano su Leonardo in $WORK/wearusfm_runs/results/passo2/emg2qwerty_ingest_report_<job>.json (copie sul Mac in ~/wearusfm_local/reports/emg2qwerty/, sha256 uguali al cluster: 59081795 1be238af...3c38, 59082182 118e42a8...3090). Tutte le 1135 registrazioni hanno condition = on_keyboard.
